verdict.rationale: Docusaurus supports MDX and embedding React components (docusaurus-docs-3, docusaurus-docs-17, docusaurus-docs-31), which could theoretically be used to build custom interactive docs, but there is no evidence of an official or first-party interactive API reference feature, OpenAPI integration, or runnable code sandbox capability — probes explicitly show no OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints (docusaurus-probe-3) and no API-reference-specific tooling is documented. missing for 10: dedicated API reference plugin/theme, runnable code execution environment, OpenAPI/Swagger spec rendering, any hands-on evidence of interactive runnable examples being used in practice.
